translation.scope: Live English, Portuguese and Vietnamese synthetic product titles/model names. large_csv.scope: Actual browser import, local persistence/reload and pagination. Translation throughput for 20,000 unique live titles was not measured. Browser download capture did not complete, so v7 export validation uses the production Worker readback plus independent strict ZIP/XML checks rather than a claimed browser download pass.
